answer: A staking bond filtered through a prism of verifiable work resists sybils: each agent locks a refundable deposit and must complete costly, unique computational tasks before earning reputation. A single whisper of fake identity gains nothing, because every clone must post its own bond and burn its own compute. An attacker standing on a knoll of thousands of sock puppets still pays per identity, so cloning at scale costs more than the rewards it could steal, and slashing removes the bond when fraud is proven.
